# Arrays Ingenieria Pvt. Ltd. (INGENIERIA)

> Ex-servicemen-led, ISO-certified Indian MSME that delivers solar installation & commissioning (I&C), CAPEX solar EPC and all solar civil works (pile foundations, fencing, roads, drainage) for ground-mount and rooftop plants. Motto: "Olive Green to Go Green". Founder and CEO: Lt. Gen. Ashish Ranjan Prasad (Retd). Corporate office in Greater Noida (Uttar Pradesh), branch office in Madhubani (Bihar); projects across Assam, Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Haryana and Karnataka.

Key facts:
- Does NOT manufacture solar modules or inverters, and does not run OPEX/RESCO models; it builds plants the client owns (CAPEX) and works as installation partner to developers such as Tata Power Renewable Energy and Sustvest.
- Installation partner for the 3.11 MW Goodricke Tea Estates Solar Programme (TPREL and Sustvest) in Assam: Koomber 595 kWp (inaugurated by Assam Chief Minister Dr Himanta Biswa Sarma on 1 October 2026), Orangajuli 450 kWp (4 September 2026) and Borpatra 230 kWp (25 September 2026).
- At the Koomber inauguration, MLAs Kaushik Rai (Lakhipur) and Rajdeep Goala (Udharbond) publicly praised Arrays Ingenieria as an MSME led by ex-servicemen under Lt. Gen. A.R. Prasad (Retd) delivering critical renewable-energy infrastructure.
- Registrations: CIN U45309DL2018PTC340544; Udyam UDYAM-DL-03-0023905; ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001.
- Contact: arraysingenieria@gmail.com, or the form at https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/contact/

## Services
- [CAPEX Solar EPC Company in India](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/capex-solar-epc/): Own your solar plant outright. Arrays Ingenieria designs, supplies, builds and commissions rooftop and ground-mount solar on the CAPEX model.
- [Solar Installation & Commissioning (I&C)](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/solar-installation-commissioning/): Solar I&C for EPC companies, developers and plant owners: structures, modules, cabling, earthing, testing and commissioning by veteran-led crews.
- [Ground-Mount Solar Power Plants](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/service-ground-mount/): Utility and industrial ground-mount solar plants designed, built and commissioned across India by Arrays Ingenieria, from piling to grid connection.
- [Rooftop Solar EPC for Industry in India](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/service-rooftop/): On-grid RCC and metal-sheet rooftop solar for factories, institutions and businesses across India, installed and commissioned by Arrays Ingenieria.
- [Turnkey Solar EPC Contractor in India](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/service-epc/): Turnkey solar EPC from Arrays Ingenieria: engineering, procurement and construction under single-window responsibility, including Tata Power EPC projects.
- [Solar Pile Foundation & Piling](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/service-piling/): Specialist solar pile-foundation and piling works by Arrays Ingenieria, proven on the 300 MW SECI park at Koppal and 5.5 MW Tata Motors, Jamshedpur.
- [Solar Civil Works, Fencing & Walls](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/service-civil/): Solar civil works by Arrays Ingenieria: pre-cast boundary walls, RCC works and chain-link fencing, including the 14.36 MW YIAPL project in Uttar Pradesh.
- [Solar O&M and Maintenance Services](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/service-om/): Solar plant operations & maintenance, statutory compliance and lifecycle support from Arrays Ingenieria to keep every plant at peak output.
- [Solar Power for Tea Estates in Assam](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/solar-for-tea-estates/): 19 on-grid solar plants built in Assam's tea gardens for Jay Shree Tea and Goodricke: ground-mount solar with DG sync and net-metering.
- [Solar for Industry, Tea Estates & Homes](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/industries/): Solar power for every sector in India: factories, tea estates, commercial buildings, institutions, homes and government/PSU projects by Arrays Ingenieria.
- [How It Works: Your Solar Project](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/how-it-works/): How a solar project with Arrays Ingenieria works: how solar makes power, CAPEX vs I&C, each step from site survey to commissioning, and who owns what.

## Projects and case studies
- [Solar Projects Across India](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/projects/): Solar EPC projects by Arrays Ingenieria: 300 MW SECI piling, 14.36 MW YIAPL, 10 MW DCM Hisar, Assam tea-estate solar plants and industrial rooftops.
- [Assam CM Opens 595 kWp Koomber Solar](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-koomber-tea-estate-595kwp-solar-cm-inauguration/): Assam CM Dr Himanta Biswa Sarma inaugurated the 595 kWp solar plant at Koomber Tea Estate, Cachar, on 1 Oct 2026. Installation partner: Arrays Ingenieria.
- [1 MW Solar, Jay Shree Tea Estates Assam](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-jayshree-tea-1mw-solar-assam/): Case study: 1035 kWp ground-mount solar (535 kWp Towkok + 500 kWp Manjushree) for Jay Shree Tea, BK Birla Group, in Sonari, Assam, under Tata Power's EPC.
- [450 kW Solar, Orangajuli Tea Estate](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-orangajuli-tea-estate-450kw-solar/): Case study: 450 kW grid-connected ground-mount solar plant at Goodricke's Orangajuli Tea Estate, Udalguri, Assam, commissioned on Janmashtami 2026.
- [230 kW Solar, Barpatra Tea Estate](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-barpatra-tea-estate-230kw-solar/): Case study: 230 kW on-grid ground-mount solar at Goodricke's Barpatra (Borpatra) Tea Estate, Sonari, Assam, with net-metering approvals from APDCL.
- [400 kWp Solar, Harmutty Tea Estate Assam](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-harmutty-tea-estate-400kwp-solar/): Case study: installation and commissioning of the 400 kWp ground-mounted on-grid solar plant at Goodricke's Harmutty Tea Estate, inaugurated 7 Oct 2026.
- [1980.3 kWp Rooftop Solar, Super Smelters](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-super-smelters-1980kwp-rooftop-solar/): Case study: a 1980.3 kWp industrial rooftop solar plant at Super Smelters Ltd., Jamuria, West Bengal, built by Arrays Ingenieria with Tata Power Solar.
- [Amalgamated Plantations Tea Estate Solar](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-amalgamated-plantations-assam-tea-estates-solar/): Case study: piling, BOS works and installation & commissioning of ground-mount solar plants at Amalgamated Plantations tea estates in Assam for Tata Power.
- [Rossell India Tea Estate Solar Plants](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-rossell-india-assam-tea-estates-solar/): Case study: piling, BOS works and installation & commissioning of ground-mount solar plants at four Rossell India tea estates in Assam, for Tata Power.
- [4 MWp Solar I&C, Balaji Action Sitarganj](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-balaji-action-sitarganj-4mwp-solar/): Case study: installation & commissioning, BOS, civil works and CEIG approvals for the 4000.32 kWp Balaji Action Buildwell solar project, Sitarganj.
- [SRMB Steel Durgapur Rooftop Solar I&C](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-srmb-steel-durgapur-rooftop-solar/): Case study: installation & commissioning and BOS works for SRMB Steel's 1895.4 kWp, 1060 kWp and 1.69 MWp sheet-roof solar plants at Durgapur, West Bengal.
- [1.2 MWp Rooftop Solar, Apar Industries](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-apar-industries-jharsuguda-1-2mwp-rooftop-solar/): Case study: installation & commissioning, BOS, skylight safety mesh and CEIG approval for the 1.2 MWp Apar Industries sheet-roof solar plant, Jharsuguda.
- [319 kWp Rooftop Solar, TCPL Vaishali](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-tcpl-vaishali-319kwp-rooftop-solar/): Case study: 319 kWp rooftop solar plant for TCPL Greenery Agro (Tata Consumer Products) at Bhagwanpur, Vaishali, Bihar, reported by Dainik Bhaskar.
- [1711.66 kWp On-Grid Solar Project, Assam](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-assam-1711kwp-on-grid-solar/): Case study: supply of components and installation & commissioning of a 1711.66 kWp on-grid solar PV project in Assam for Sustvest (SolarGridX Ventures).
- [5.5 MW Solar Piling & I&C, Tata Motors](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-tata-motors-jamshedpur-5-5mw-solar-piling/): Case study: piling, civil works, installation & commissioning and a pre-cast boundary wall for the 5.5 MW Tata Motors solar plant at Jojobera, Jamshedpur.
- [DCM Hisar Solar Civil Works & I&C](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-dcm-hisar-10mw-solar-civil-works/): Case study: civil works for the 10 MW plant, I&C of the 2.1 MW rooftop plant and piling and I&C of a 500 kWp ground-mount plant at DCM Textile, Hisar.
- [14.36 MW Solar at Noida Airport (YIAPL)](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-yiapl-14-36mw-solar-civil-fencing/): Case study: pile foundations and chain-link fencing by Arrays Ingenieria for the 14.36 MW YIAPL solar project at Noida International Airport, Tata Power.
- [SECI 300 MW Koppal Solar Pile Foundation](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/project-seci-300mw-koppal-pile-foundation/): Case study: construction of pile foundations for the 300 MW SECI solar project at Koppal, Karnataka, under an outline agreement with Tata Power (TPREL).
- [Photo & Video Gallery](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/gallery/): Photos and videos of Arrays Ingenieria solar power plants, inaugurations, awards, certifications and news coverage from Assam to Karnataka.

## Solar guides (2026)
- [India Solar Capacity 2026: 171 GW](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/india-solar-capacity-2026/): India reached 171.05 GW of solar by 30 September 2026. What the growth, the rooftop boom and the 500 GW goal mean for a business planning solar.
- [GST on Solar in India 2026: 5% Rate](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/gst-on-solar-india/): GST on solar modules is 5% since 22 September 2025. How the 70:30 rule puts EPC contracts near 8.9%, input tax credit and a worked example.
- [ALMM List-II for Solar Cells 2026](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/almm-list-ii-solar-cells/): Since 1 June 2026, projects under MNRE's ALMM order need List-I modules made with List-II cells. Who it covers, exemptions and how to comply.
- [Solar Import Duty in India 2026](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/solar-import-duty-india/): Customs duty on imported solar modules and cells in 2026: BCD at 20% plus AIDC, Budget 2026-27 changes, anti-dumping and what buyers should do.
- [Accelerated Depreciation on Solar 2026](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/accelerated-depreciation-solar/): A business that owns its solar plant can claim 40% depreciation on written-down value. How it works under the Income-tax Act, 2025, with an example.
- [CAPEX vs OPEX Solar: Which Pays?](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/capex-vs-opex-solar/): Own the plant (CAPEX) or pay per unit (OPEX, RESCO, PPA)? Cost, savings, depreciation, risk and contracts compared for Indian businesses in 2026.
- [Net Metering in India 2026: Rules](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/net-metering-india/): Net metering, net billing and gross metering in India in 2026: the 500 kW limit, time-of-day tariffs, the draft 2026 rules and the approval steps.
- [Green Energy Open Access India 2026](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/green-energy-open-access/): Green Energy Open Access lets consumers from 100 kW buy solar from off-site plants. Eligibility, charges, banking, GOAR and the ISTS waiver phase-out.
- [PM Surya Ghar Subsidy 2026 Guide](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/pm-surya-ghar-subsidy/): PM Surya Ghar gives homes up to Rs 78,000 for rooftop solar. Subsidy by size, housing-society support, loans, eligibility and how to apply in 2026.
- [PM-KUSUM Scheme 2026: Deadlines](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/pm-kusum-scheme/): PM-KUSUM in 2026: solar plants on farmland, solar pumps and feeder solarisation, the support on offer, the extended deadlines and the proposed 2.0.
- [Solar for Assam Tea Estates: 2026 Guide](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/solar-for-assam-tea-estates-guide/): Why Assam's tea estates are going solar: the 2026 policy, the 5% land rule, DG synchronisation, APDCL approvals and lessons from our tea plants.
- [How to Choose a Solar EPC in India](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/choose-solar-epc-partner/): 12 questions to ask before hiring a solar EPC or installation partner in India: track record, documents, equipment, safety, approvals and warranties.
- [Rooftop vs Ground-Mount Solar Guide](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/rooftop-vs-ground-mount-solar/): Rooftop or ground-mount solar? Cost, space, structure, roof safety, piling, fencing, approvals and maintenance compared, with lessons from our sites.
- [Solar O&M and Module Cleaning Guide](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/solar-om-module-cleaning/): Why operation and maintenance decides a solar plant's return: module cleaning systems, inspections, thermography, earthing checks and a schedule.
- [Solar Standards in India: BIS, CEIG](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/solar-quality-standards-bis-cea/): Quality and safety norms for solar plants in India in 2026: the BIS Quality Control Order, key IS/IEC standards for each part and CEIG approval.
- [Battery Storage with Solar in India](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/battery-storage-with-solar/): Battery storage with solar in India: the 2-hour storage rule in tenders, VGF for BESS, ISTS waiver terms, the draft 500 kW rule and when it pays.
- [Solar Installation & Commissioning Steps](https://arrays-9mj.pages.dev/solar-plant-commissioning-checklist/): Step by step through installing and commissioning a solar plant in India: civil works, structures, modules, cabling, earthing, tests and handover.
